_meta.definition: headline set piece = goal from a possession starting From Corner / From Free Kick (StatsBomb play_pattern) scored within 15s of the dead-ball delivery; direct free-kick goals = 0s; penalties counted separately; throw-ins tallied but excluded from the headline (Opta commentary never attributes them, so 2026 can't count them either); shootout kicks excluded; own goals classified by the play_pattern of the conceding event
_meta.caveat: windows direct_10s / direct_15s / whole_possession are all included so the definitional sensitivity is visible; headline uses direct_15s to approximate Opta's 'following a corner / set piece' phase attribution used for 2026
